prompts: To begin, are you or anyone in your household, currently or formerly employed in any of the following?
Are you (or another member of your household) responsible for any of the following within a bank, insurance company, brokerage, financial planning or financial company?
Thinking of various financial activities available on the internet, which of the following do you currently do, or might be interested in doing in the next year or two?
Which of the following do you use for your savings and investments? [Check all that apply]
Thinking of your savings and investments, how likely would you be to interact with your financial institution in the following ways?
Generally speaking, how interested would you be in having access to more digital material, tools and/or applications to help you with your finances?
Before today, have you ever heard of the term robo-advisor?
Are you currently using a robo-advisor service for some or all of your investments?
How likely or unlikely would you be to consider using a robo-advisor service in the next year or two?
How much of your savings and investments are you managing or would you consider managing with a robo-advisor service?
Whether or not you currently use a robo-advisor service, how much do you agree or disagree with the following as reasons why you WOULD use a robo-advisor service?
How much of a concern, if any, would each of the following be to you using a robo-advisor service?
Which of the following service features, if any, would you find most useful in a robo-advisor service? [Check all that apply]
Which of the following technical features, if any, were important in considering or would be important for you to consider using a robo-advisor service? [Check all that apply]
Thinking of your own finances, how much would you think a reasonable monthly fee would be to use a robo-advisor service that offered all the features that you considered important?
Based on what you know today, generally speaking what would be your view of robo-advisor services?
When you hear the word "risk" as it relates to your finances, do you…?
In terms of your risk tolerance as it relates to investing, how would you categorize yourself?
Do you currently have a financial advisor that you use to help you with your financial investments?
Overall, how satisfied or dissatisfied are you with your current financial advisor? If you have more than one, consider your main financial advisor.
Which of the following statements best describes how your financial decisions are made?
[IF USES ROBO-ADVISOR IN Q.8] What impact, if any, has using a robo-advisor service had on your relationship with your financial advisor?
[IF LIKELY TO USE ROBO-ADVISOR IN Q.9] If you were to use a robo-advisor service, what impact, if any, would this have on your relationship with your financial advisor?
In what year were you born?
